items.label: Who and which coupon
items.message: IM7-UNT-L1, unnotched tension; a new coupon: its folder and case page are written when it runs

items.label: Units consistent
items.message: every row in mm, MPa and N; the results come back in the same units, and the decks are written in mm-MPa

items.label: Geometry defined
items.message: 250 by 25 mm, 56 mm tabs with a node row on each tab line

items.label: Test standard
items.message: specimen checked against ASTM D3039/D3039M-17, balanced and symmetric class (Table 2): 5 of 5 requirements a model can meet are met; 1 recommendation not followed; 12 clauses of the procedure are the laboratory's

requirements.text: The material is a polymer-matrix composite reinforced by high-modulus fibres.
requirements.limit: a polymer-matrix composite reinforced by high-modulus fibres

requirements.text: The laminate is balanced and symmetric about the direction of the pull: a −θ ply for every +θ ply, and the stack a mirror image about its mid-plane.
requirements.limit: balanced and symmetric about the direction of the pull

requirements.text: The coupon has a constant rectangular cross-section.
The length is at least the gripped length, plus twice the width, plus the gauge length of the strain measurement (we read the gripped length as both grips together).
requirements.limit: at least 187 mm (2 × 56 mm gripped + 2 × 25 mm wide + 25 mm gauge)

requirements.text: Bonded tabs are bevelled at 5° to 90°, both included.
The width suggested for the laminate's class.
requirements.limit: 25 mm for a balanced and symmetric coupon

requirements.text: The overall length suggested for the laminate's class.
requirements.limit: 250 mm for a balanced and symmetric coupon

requirements.text: The laminate thickness suggested for the laminate's class.
requirements.limit: 2.5 mm for a balanced and symmetric coupon

requirements.text: The tab length suggested for the laminate's class.
requirements.value: balanced and symmetric: Table 2 gives no tab length
requirements.limit: gripped through emery cloth; the grip length is yours to state

requirements.text: The tab thickness suggested for the laminate's class.
requirements.limit: emery cloth for this class; bonded tabs are allowed (§8.2.1.2)

requirements.text: The tab bevel suggested for the laminate's class.
An extensometer's gauge length lies between 10 and 50 mm [0.5 and 2.0 in].
A bonded strain gauge's active length is at least 3 mm [0.125 in]; 6 mm [0.25 in] suits most materials.
Off-axis plies soften the free edges, so the strength and stiffness of an angle-ply laminate can read low.
requirements.limit: edge softening can make the measured strength and stiffness read low; less so with many 0° plies

requirements.text: The specimen's width is within ±1 % of its width.
The specimen's thickness is within ±4 % of its thickness.
The specimen lies flat under light finger pressure.
Bonded tabs match in thickness within ±1 % and are feathered into the coupon without damaging it.
Width and thickness are measured at three places in the gauge section, and the area is their average width times their average thickness.
At least five specimens are tested per condition.
The conditioning is reported; without one, the specimens are reported as unconditioned, moisture unknown.
The strain rate gives failure in 1 to 10 minutes: 0.01 per minute in strain control, or 2 mm/min [0.05 in/min] of the head as a start.
Bending is checked with back-to-back transducers on at least one specimen per sample at 2000 µε; above 3 % the strains of both faces are averaged.
The load train's alignment is checked; good practice keeps bending to 3 to 5 % above 1000 µε.
Each failure is recorded with the three-part code of the failure type, area and location.
When many specimens fail within one width of a tab or grip, the gripping is re-examined.

items.label: Material defined
items.message: IM7-8552-Lamina: library im7-8552 / ncamp-im7-8552-2019-rtd-measured-v1 (record 2026-10-10.1; Hexcel 8552 IM7 unidirectional prepreg 190 gsm 35% RC · qualification material property data report · CAM-RP-2009-015 · Rev B · Wichita State University · NIAR / NCAMP · 2019-04-16); rights class open-publisher; strengths given

items.label: Laminate assigned
items.message: 8 plies [45/0/-45/90]s, 1.46304 mm thick; symmetric, so B = 0 and the membrane model applies

items.label: Constraints defined
items.message: bottom grip held in every direction (72 nodes), top grip held across the width (72 nodes), through a reference point at each end; no rigid-body motion is left

items.label: Load applied
items.message: displacement of 1 mm on the top grip along the coupon, a pull

items.label: Mesh quality acceptable
items.message: 250 elements, 306 nodes (structured mesh, order 1); aspect ratio 1.02 at worst (warns above 10); smallest angle 90° at worst (warns below 10°); largest angle 90° at worst (warns above 160°); Jacobian ratio 1 at worst (warns below 0.1)

items.label: Result points inside the coupon
items.message: results are read at node centre at (15, 125), element centre, element near_grip (mm)
